name: Drehzentrum Ilzauer GmbH
summary: Drehzentrum Ilzauer is a founder-owned turning shop (20 staff, 2-5 M EUR turnover) with idle capacity: its second shift has been on hold since spring, it is advertising free machine capacity and it has paused hiring. It calls Hollerau an important reference customer, is irritated by our chronic late payment and has asked for 10-day payment against a cash discount. Its owner admits he has not tracked material and energy costs since 2022, and a new quote for the shaft sleeve at 30.03 EUR (current price 11.66) suggests a costing reset or an error.

situation.decision_maker: owner (founder) decides; office manager prepares the costing; sales rep handles capacity and offers

negotiation_pattern: Asks for modest annual increases (mean +2.53 %) and settles about 2.5 pp lower (mean -0.01 %). Shaft sleeve and spacer sleeve, which have second sources, settled at 0 % or below in every round (down to -3.6 %). Only the single-sourced wear ring set got real increases (+5.2 % in 2025, +3.1 % in 2026). It reacts to unfair treatment rather than to price pressure: it complained about overdue invoices and threatened to 'review our conditions'. It does not fight hard on price.
wants: additional volume and parts to fill free capacity and the paused second shift
payment on time, ideally within 10 days (offers a cash discount in return)
keeping Hollerau as a reference customer and a longer, secure relationship
a price catch-up for cost increases it has not tracked since 2022
protects: unit_price on part:320040 wear ring set (single source, the only part where it pushed increases through)
the agreed payment terms (30 days net), which it insists we keep
possibly the new price level for part:320020 in quote:7300062 (unclear, clarify first)

trades.give: volume_per_year up: raise quota on part:320020 (now 60 %) and part:320090 (now 50 %), or add new parts
trades.get: unit_price held or reduced for 2027 and quote:7300062 (30.03 EUR) withdrawn; lead_time_days below 28
trades.why: Free capacity and a paused second shift make volume worth more to them than price.

trades.give: payment_days down to 10 days, with a commitment to actually pay on time
trades.get: a cash discount (their offer) or price hold on all three parts
trades.why: They asked for exactly this; we currently pay late 97 % of the time, about 10.4 days after due.

trades.give: contract_months: extend the framework agreement beyond 2027-06-30 with a volume forecast
trades.get: unit_price fixed for 2027 and longer; no index_clause
trades.why: Forecast and contract length give security to a small shop looking for customers.

trades.give: volume security / extra parts made conditional on quality
trades.get: ppm_commitment below the current 1000 ppm, OTD toward the 95 % target, overdue 8Ds closed; chargeback_eur_per_complaint kept at 150
trades.why: OTD is 84.4 % against a 95 % target and 2 8D reports are overdue; extra volume is the lever to fix this.

arguments.point: We can fill your free capacity: more share on the shaft sleeve and spacer sleeve, against stable prices and better delivery.
We acknowledge the late payments and will fix them, up to 10-day payment if they grant the cash discount they offered.
As your reference customer we need delivery reliability: OTD is 84.4 % against a contractual 95 %, ppm is 1000 and 2 8D reports are overdue.
Prices are fixed per calendar year. Any 2027 change needs written notice 90 days before year end (by about 2026-10-02), so a +157 % quote outside that process cannot simply replace the price annex.
Hollerau owns the tooling on all three parts and has second sources on two of them.

avoid: Demanding price cuts while we keep paying late: they have already threatened to 'review our conditions'.
Pressing an owner who admits not tracking his costs into prices below cost. This risks a sudden repricing or putting a 20-person shop under strain, and part:320040 has no second source.
Openly threatening to move tooling or quota away. Use it only as quiet background; volume is the better lever.
Accepting quote:7300062 at 30.03 EUR without asking for a cost breakdown.
tone: Personal, fair and direct to the owner: acknowledge our payment lapses, offer volume and on-time payment, and be firm on quality and price stability.
red_flags: quote:7300062 prices part:320020 at 30.03 EUR against the current 11.66 EUR (+157 %). This is either a costing catch-up or an error; clarify before the 90-day notice window (about 2026-10-02) closes.
The owner does not follow material and energy costs (office manager does the costing). There is a risk of abrupt price corrections or margin squeeze.
part:320040 wear ring set is single source with 100 % quota (tooling is ours, but there is no qualified alternative).
Delivery is well below target (OTD 84.4 % vs 95 %), the scorecard has been amber for three quarters, and 5 8D reports are open, 2 of them overdue.
Payment friction: they threatened to review conditions over overdue invoices. Hiring is paused and capacity is idle, which signals a weaker order book; the credit index is stable at 249.
